test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The scholar examined the** chancel **at the east end of the church.

options.text: The chancel was elevated above the nave by a few steps.
The concert began in the chancel with chamber musicians.
The builder reinforced the chancel arch using steel ties.
The chemist analyzed the properties of a synthetic chancel.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"chancel"** refers to the part of a church near the altar, reserved for clergy and choir. (चर्च का वह भाग जो पादरी और गायकों के लिए सुरक्षित होता है)
 
 
• **Example:** The chancel was decorated with beautiful stained-glass windows.
 
 
• The correct word, **"chancel"** in Option 4, is used as a homonym in a different context, describing a synthetic material. (सिंथेटिक चांसल)
 
 
• **Example:** The chemist analyzed the properties of a synthetic chancel to determine its durability.
 
 
• Hence, Option 4 contains a homonym of "chancel" and is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 1:** The chancel was elevated above the nave by a few steps. (चांसल को नैव के ऊपर कुछ सीढ़ियों से उठाया गया था।)
 
 
• **Example:** The elevated chancel provided a clear view of the altar.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The concert began in the chancel with chamber musicians. (चांसल में चेंबर संगीतकारों के साथ संगीत कार्यक्रम शुरू हुआ।)
 
 
• **Example:** The acoustics in the chancel were perfect for chamber music.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The builder reinforced the chancel arch using steel ties. (निर्माता ने चांसल आर्च को स्टील टाई का उपयोग करके मजबूत किया।)
 
 
• **Example:** The chancel arch was carefully restored to preserve its original design.
